name: Ising Spin Domains
desc: A 2D Ising ferromagnet flickering near its critical temperature — indigo and gold spin domains nucleate, coarsen and dissolve behind glowing writhing walls as the lattice is slowly swept from frozen order through fractal criticality into hot noise.

temp.doc: temperature bias around Tc (0=frozen order, .5=critical, 1=hot noise)

scale.doc: lattice coarseness (higher = chunkier domains / fewer cells)

hue.doc: palette base hue (down-spin color; up-spin is +155)
